explanation: Pooled base interaction is the 2021 reference gradient under the pooled parameterization; it is jointly estimated with common slopes and pooled composition.

Pooled 2024 gradient is base interaction plus the 2024 triple interaction; separate and pooled regressions need not coincide because coefficients are jointly estimated with pooled controls, FE, weights and composition.
Both are descriptive contrasts; no new equality test was pre-specified, so the contrast is not assigned a formal p-value here.
